```{r setup}
#| include: false
# Supplement — every table is rendered DIRECTLY from a committed results CSV
# (values come from the file, not hand-typed). A few sentinel stopifnot guards
# assert structural facts (row counts, one known value per source) so the
# render fails if an input drifts. results/ is READ-ONLY input.
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(here)))
res <- function(...) here::here("results", ...)
fmt <- function(x, k = 2) formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = k)
ci  <- function(lo, hi, k = 2) paste0("[", fmt(lo, k), ", ", fmt(hi, k), "]")
kb  <- function(df, cap) knitr::kable(df, caption = cap, align = "l")

s7  <- read.csv(res("step7_REALDATA_descriptive.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
s15 <- read.csv(res("step15_CONFDB_contrast.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
s14 <- read.csv(res("step14_SIMULATION_confdb_nullref.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
r2  <- read.csv(res("step2_REALDATA_reliability.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
r11 <- read.csv(res("step11_CONFDB_reliability.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
s8i <- read.csv(res("step8_SIMULATION_ipsative_exhibit.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
s9i <- read.csv(res("step9_REALDATA_ipsative_exhibit.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# sentinel guards
stopifnot(nrow(s7) == 5L)
stopifnot(abs(s7$rho_level[s7$pair=="vision_x_GDP"] - 0.464) < 5e-4)
stopifnot(sum(s15$subset=="exploratory_pairs" & s15$quantity=="gap") == 6L)
stopifnot(nrow(s14) == 8L)
prettypair <- function(p) gsub("_x_", " x ", p)
```

# S1. Full descriptive tier (Lund, five pairs) {#sec-s1}

Uncorrected latent correlations; each gap carries its frozen systematic-bias
band. Source: `results/step7_REALDATA_descriptive.csv`.

```{r}
s1 <- data.frame(
  Pair = prettypair(s7$pair),
  `n (both / complete)` = paste0(s7$n_both, " / ", s7$n_complete),
  `rho_level [95% CI]` = paste0(fmt(s7$rho_level), " ", ci(s7$rho_level_lo, s7$rho_level_hi)),
  `rho_sens (uncorr.) [95% CI]` = paste0(fmt(s7$rho_sens_uncorrected), " ", ci(s7$rho_sens_lo, s7$rho_sens_hi)),
  `gap [95% CI]` = paste0(fmt(s7$gap_uncorrected), " ", ci(s7$gap_lo, s7$gap_hi)),
  band = paste0("+/-", fmt(s7$bias_band, 2)),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kb(s1, NULL)
```

# S2. Arbuzova_unpub_3 — all six pairs (EXPLORATORY) {#sec-s2}

Exploratory. Motor and visuomotor are two conditions of one skittles
paradigm, so only memory × visual is a clean cross-domain pair. Source:
`results/step15_CONFDB_contrast.csv` (subset `exploratory_pairs`).

```{r}
ex <- s15[s15$subset == "exploratory_pairs", ]
pairs <- unique(ex$pair)
getq <- function(p, q, col) ex[[col]][ex$pair == p & ex$quantity == q]
s2 <- data.frame(
  Pair = pairs,
  n = sapply(pairs, function(p) unique(ex$n_subjects[ex$pair == p])),
  `r_level [95% CI]` = sapply(pairs, function(p) paste0(fmt(getq(p,"r_level","estimate"))," ",ci(getq(p,"r_level","ci_lo"),getq(p,"r_level","ci_hi")))),
  `r_sens [95% CI]` = sapply(pairs, function(p) paste0(fmt(getq(p,"r_sens","estimate"))," ",ci(getq(p,"r_sens","ci_lo"),getq(p,"r_sens","ci_hi")))),
  `gap [95% CI]` = sapply(pairs, function(p) paste0(fmt(getq(p,"gap","estimate"))," ",ci(getq(p,"gap","ci_lo"),getq(p,"gap","ci_hi")))),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
kb(s2, NULL)
```

# S3. Confidence Database secondaries {#sec-s3}

Bang catch-inclusion and author-exclusion variants, Haddara feedback-group
heterogeneity check, and Spearman (scale-robustness) and un-partialed
(d′-confound exhibit) correlations. No tests; side-by-side reporting only.
Source: `results/step15_CONFDB_contrast.csv`.

```{r}
subs <- s15[s15$subset %in% c("B-s1","B-s2","H-s1_feedback","H-s1_no_feedback"), ]
units <- unique(subs$subset)
gq <- function(u,q,col) subs[[col]][subs$subset==u & subs$quantity==q]
s3a <- data.frame(
  Unit = c("B-s1 (Bang, catch-included)","B-s2 (Bang, no author-excluded 179-201)",
           "H-s1 feedback (Haddara Task-1 feedback)","H-s1 no-feedback (Haddara Task-1 no-fb)"),
  n = sapply(units, function(u) unique(subs$n_subjects[subs$subset==u])),
  `r_level [95% CI]` = sapply(units, function(u) paste0(fmt(gq(u,"r_level","estimate"))," ",ci(gq(u,"r_level","ci_lo"),gq(u,"r_level","ci_hi")))),
  `r_sens [95% CI]` = sapply(units, function(u) paste0(fmt(gq(u,"r_sens","estimate"))," ",ci(gq(u,"r_sens","ci_lo"),gq(u,"r_sens","ci_hi")))),
  `gap [95% CI]` = sapply(units, function(u) paste0(fmt(gq(u,"gap","estimate"))," ",ci(gq(u,"gap","ci_lo"),gq(u,"gap","ci_hi")))),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
kb(s3a, "S3a. Bang/Haddara subset variants.")

studies <- c("Arbuzova_2021_expt2","Arbuzova_unpub_3","Bang_2019_Exp2","Haddara_2022_Expt1")
sp <- s15[s15$subset=="primary" & s15$tier=="SECONDARY", ]
gsp <- function(st,q,col) sp[[col]][sp$study==st & sp$quantity==q]
s3b <- data.frame(
  Study = studies,
  `Spearman r_level [95% CI]` = sapply(studies,function(s) paste0(fmt(gsp(s,"r_level_spearman","estimate"))," ",ci(gsp(s,"r_level_spearman","ci_lo"),gsp(s,"r_level_spearman","ci_hi")))),
  `Spearman r_sens [95% CI]` = sapply(studies,function(s) paste0(fmt(gsp(s,"r_sens_spearman","estimate"))," ",ci(gsp(s,"r_sens_spearman","ci_lo"),gsp(s,"r_sens_spearman","ci_hi")))),
  `r_sens_raw (un-partialed) [95% CI]` = sapply(studies,function(s) paste0(fmt(gsp(s,"r_sens_raw","estimate"))," ",ci(gsp(s,"r_sens_raw","ci_lo"),gsp(s,"r_sens_raw","ci_hi")))),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
kb(s3b, "S3b. Scale-robustness (Spearman) and the d'-confound exhibit (un-partialed r_sens).")
```

# S4. Null-reference simulation: achieved vs. target reliabilities {#sec-s4}

The per-study SIMULATION null-reference gate matched each study's split-half
reliabilities; the table shows achieved vs. target and the resulting
true-null raw-gap interval. Gate PASS: worst reliability deviation 0.022.
Source: `results/step14_SIMULATION_confdb_nullref.csv`.

```{r}
s4 <- data.frame(
  Study = s14$study,
  `rho_null` = fmt(s14$rho_null, 2),
  `rel level a (ach/tgt)` = paste0(fmt(s14$achieved_rel_level_a,3),"/",fmt(s14$target_rel_level_a,3)),
  `rel AUROC2 a (ach/tgt)` = paste0(fmt(s14$achieved_rel_auroc2_a,3),"/",fmt(s14$target_rel_auroc2_a,3)),
  `rel level b (ach/tgt)` = paste0(fmt(s14$achieved_rel_level_b,3),"/",fmt(s14$target_rel_level_b,3)),
  `rel AUROC2 b (ach/tgt)` = paste0(fmt(s14$achieved_rel_auroc2_b,3),"/",fmt(s14$target_rel_auroc2_b,3)),
  `max abs dev` = fmt(s14$max_abs_rel_dev, 3),
  `null raw-gap [2.5%, 97.5%]` = ci(s14$gap_raw_null_lo, s14$gap_raw_null_hi),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kb(s4, NULL)
```

# S5. Reliability tables {#sec-s5}

```{r}
sh <- r2[r2$kind=="splithalf_SB", ]
s5a <- data.frame(
  Domain = sh$domain, Measure = sh$measure,
  `reliability [95% CI]` = paste0(fmt(sh$reliability)," ",ci(sh$ci_lo, sh$ci_hi)),
  n = sh$n_subjects, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
kb(s5a, "S5a. Lund split-half (Spearman-Brown) reliabilities. Source: step2_REALDATA_reliability.csv.")

s5b <- data.frame(
  Study = r11$study, Task = r11$task, Measure = r11$measure,
  `reliability [95% CI]` = paste0(fmt(r11$rel_sb)," ",ci(r11$ci_lo, r11$ci_hi)),
  n = r11$n_subjects, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
kb(s5b, "S5b. Confidence Database odd/even (Spearman-Brown) reliabilities. Source: step11_CONFDB_reliability.csv.")
```

# S6. Ipsative artifact exhibit (METHODS EXHIBIT — never evidence) {#sec-s6}

The naive grand-mean-centered within-subject correlations that the
non-ipsative multilevel model exists to avoid: manufactured negativity in
real data and in matched simulation under a planted null. Sources:
`results/step9_REALDATA_ipsative_exhibit.csv`,
`results/step8_SIMULATION_ipsative_exhibit.csv`.

```{r}
s6a <- data.frame(
  Pair = prettypair(paste0(s9i$domain_a,"_x_",s9i$domain_b)),
  `naive centred r (real)` = fmt(s9i$r_centered, 3),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kb(s6a, "S6a. Real-data naive-centred correlations (memory x vision -0.667 ... Calories x GDP 0.083).")

# simulation: mean over replicates per pair
agg <- aggregate(r_centered ~ domain_a + domain_b, data = s8i, FUN = mean)
s6b <- data.frame(
  Pair = prettypair(paste0(agg$domain_a,"_x_",agg$domain_b)),
  `naive centred r (sim, mean over 10 reps)` = fmt(agg$r_centered, 3),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kb(s6b, "S6b. Simulation planted-null naive-centred correlations (mechanical expectation ~ -1/3 for four exchangeable domains).")
```
